verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into an active Counter Strike or force all-ins before 6; you win by stacking kills for permanent max health and letting the lane scale out.

brief.thesis: Jax's E (Counter Strike) dodges all incoming basic attacks for its duration, then stuns and damages everyone around him when it ends — every auto you throw into that window is wasted and you eat the stun for free. Sion doesn't need to win short trades: Enrage (E) permanently raises his max health on every kill and Death's Caress (W) can absorb or front-load damage instead of relying on autos, so the 54.6% win rate over 119 games comes from out-scaling, not out-trading. Jax still owns the solo-kill column because Counter Strike baits and punishes impatient all-ins — respect that and this lane is close to free.

theirWindow.when: His E and W both ready
theirWindow.what: He'll pop Counter Strike to dodge your autos and Q, then stun and burst with an Empowered hit. Don't throw Cryptic Gaze (Q) or autos into the stance — back off or wait the ~1s out before committing anything.

yourWindow.what: He has no way to dodge or escape for its full cooldown (18/16/14/12/10s). Land Q (Cryptic Gaze) from 550 range to stun him, pop W (Death's Caress) for the shield, and freely trade autos with Enrage (E) active.

powerCurve.note: Both squishy, trades are even pokes

start.why: Reduces incoming basic attack damage and heals on taking harass — directly blunts Jax's early auto-trading and Leap Strike pokes (62.3% win rate over 61 games).

boots.why: Flat reduction on basic attack damage counters Jax's whole kit, which snowballs off autos via Relentless Assault's stacking attack speed (54.8% win rate, 66.4% pick).

core.why: Stacks bonus health from proc'ing on nearby units, compounding the max-health scaling Enrage (E) already gives you from kills.
Shields and sustain on taking damage let you stand in extended trades where Jax's attack speed stacking would otherwise punish you.
Punishes Jax's auto-reliant Relentless Assault directly, and grants grievous wounds against his self-sustain from items.

situational.when: the lane is passive and you want more threat to punish his cooldown windows
his team has multiple squishies you can burn down in extended skirmishes
you need more magic resist and anti-heal against a sustain-heavy enemy comp

runes.keystoneWhy: Procs off landing autos regardless of whether Jax tries to dodge with Counter Strike, and the permanent health growth reinforces the exact scaling plan (Enrage kills) that wins this matchup over time.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is run in 85.9% of games at a 54.7% win rate — Teleport lets you reset to full resources and return to a scaling lane rather than forcing a fight you don't need, while Flash covers your Q stun setup or a dodge of his Leap Strike engage.

playing.title: Never auto into active Counter Strike
playing.detail: Jax's E dodges all incoming basic attacks for its duration, then stuns and damages everything around him on expiry. If you see the stance pop, stop attacking and disengage — resume once it's down.

playing.title: Punish Leap Strike's long cooldown
playing.detail: Early levels, his Q is on a 17-11s cooldown — once he leaps in or away, he has no gap-closer for a long stretch. That's your window to land Cryptic Gaze (Q) from 550 range.

playing.title: Pop W before his Empowered hit lands
playing.detail: His W buffs his next attack or Leap Strike with bonus damage that also hits nearby enemies. Activate Death's Caress (W) first so the shield eats that hit instead of your health bar.

playing.title: Hold all-ins until level 6
playing.detail: Solo-kill favors Jax pre-6 because Counter Strike's stun secures extended fights. Wait for Cannibalism (R) to come online so your leech sustains you through the trade.

playing.title: Last-hit aggressively for E stacks
playing.detail: Enrage permanently raises max health on every kill, including minions. Prioritize secure last hits even under some risk — it's your core win condition for outscaling his flat AD.

playing.title: Buy armor before his item spikes
playing.detail: Per the matchup data, get Plated Steelcaps and Thornmail online before his second item — his autos only get scarier as Relentless Assault's attack speed stacks.

playing.title: Use Teleport to reset, not to gank
playing.detail: This matchup rewards patience and scaling over cross-map aggression — bring Teleport back to lane with full HP/mana after shoving rather than spending it on side-lane plays.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, boots, runes, summoners, and win rates above come from measured games on the current patch (OP.GG); the core item path (Heartsteel > Unending Despair > Thornmail) is drawn from a small 5-game sample, so treat item order as directionally correct rather than exact. All tactical reasoning — the Counter Strike dodge window, the Leap Strike punish timing, and the kill-stacking scaling plan — is my own read of the ability text, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid fighting him when your skills are on cooldown. Purchase items with armor before farming lane.
